title: Beaumont Carnegie Library exterior, 2016

date.basis: Wikimedia Commons identifies the self-made photograph's creation date as August 16, 2016.

caption: Luren Dickinson's August 16, 2016 exterior view of Beaumont's Carnegie library, showing the restored 1914 parapet and elevated central entrance from East Eighth Street.
description: Luren Dickinson's 2016 photograph looks across East Eighth Street toward Beaumont's working Carnegie library, its elevated entrance centered above a split staircase and its restored stepped parapet, 1914 medallion, pilasters and arched windows clearly visible between mature hedges and trees. The building is Riverside County's last remaining Carnegie library and its oldest continuously occupied library building; a 1965 rear addition more than doubled its floor area, while the shallow mansard installed in 1977/78 was removed in 2008 to reveal the original roofline seen here.
